context_varying_parameters.name: sex_probability_f
context_varying_parameters.reason: Honor single-sex source strata; choose 0.5 for the unspecified target category composition under the explicit code mapping assumption.

context_varying_parameters.name: anchor_ids
context_varying_parameters.reason: Each source context uses its own reported marginal anchors. The target analog uses all six anchors, partitioned by encoded sex; no source stratum is identified as a target lifestyle category.

context_varying_parameters.name: anchor_weights
context_varying_parameters.reason: Single source weight is one. Target sources are equally weighted within sex for log locations and source-derived HDL variances; these are analog weights, not known source sampling weights or statistical precision.

context_varying_parameters.name: bmi_log_sd
context_varying_parameters.reason: Source 0.18 and target 0.22 are fixed unidentified marginal dispersion assumptions, with wider target variability because its health/lifestyle selection is not specified.

context_varying_parameters.name: tc_log_sd
context_varying_parameters.reason: Source 0.22 and target 0.26 are assumed marginal log SDs before the additional target measurement term; no CI-to-SD conversion is used.

context_varying_parameters.name: hdl_dispersion_multiplier
context_varying_parameters.reason: Sources retain the derived marginal log SD with multiplier 1. The target uses 1.10 times the root average source-derived variance within sex, an explicit heterogeneity assumption rather than a fitted variance.

context_varying_parameters.name: extra_lipid_measurement_log_sd
context_varying_parameters.reason: Source observed margins already absorb measurement variation. The target receives an additional independent log SD of 0.06 per lipid as a provisional assay contribution with zero assumed log bias; no assay harmonization is asserted.
